gem_guidance.text: The Shoulderpads of the Stranger setup is a bit starved for hit rating, but makes up for it with other stats. If you choose Shoulderpads of the Stranger , you'll want to switch most of your Glinting Noble Topaz to Rigid Dawnstone . The gems shown here are for the recommended Bloodsea Brigand's Vest setup.

title: Rogue DPS Best in Slot (BiS) Phase 2 Gear Guide - TBC Classic - Wowhead
